item.title: Contested Latecomers in ICT Standardization: The Case of Rising Standards Powers
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines how emerging economies and late entrants navigate the complex landscape of international ICT standardization. The focus is on understanding the strategies, challenges, and power dynamics faced by rising standards powers as they attempt to influence or participate in global standardization processes that have traditionally been dominated by established technological leaders.

Appel publié par Telecommunications Policy. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Participation of emerging economies in ICT standardization
  • Late entry into global standards development
  • Power dynamics in standardization bodies
  • Rising standards powers and their strategies
  • Challenges and opportunities for latecomers in ICT standardization
  • Institutional frameworks of standardization organizations
  • Technical and political barriers to standardization participation
